attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The corpus keeps ten other Marcians and none of them is of Syracuse: this one was ordained bishop by the Apostle Peter and sent to Syracuse in Sicily. No year is given — the page's only chronology is the ordination by Peter, which is not a date — so no `dates` object. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
